confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and supplied context, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are the most reliable. Hostel and hotel rates vary widely by district and season, and anchors assume taxes and service charges are included. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer and restaurant price relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX observation comes from search results pointing to rba.gov.au; the RBA page itself was not opened and the snippet notes that cached copies show different dates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Southeast Asian capital cities with similar tourism-driven pricing (for example Bangkok and Kuala Lumpur), adjusted for Jakarta's lower restaurant prices and higher hotel tax and service load. July 2026 is dry season and school-holiday peak, so accommodation anchors are set at moderately high levels.
